definitions.round_trip: one call to the database driver: a query, or a batch of statements sent together (one HTTP request on the edge drivers)
definitions.statement: one SQL statement; a batch of n statements counts n
definitions.cold: the first render of the root card by a new engine over a database holding only the fixture and its type card
definitions.nest_levels_below_root: chain of n cards: n - 1; fan: 1; tree of depth d: d

causes.what: the requested card, fetched by name

one batch of 13 fixed lookups before the walk: the root row by id, the codename table, the permission parties and read rules, two rule-closure walks, the deck's type list, a few named cards, and the deck_data_version freshness stamp
one batch per further level of nesting: every card the previous level nests, fetched together

the derived-state prime before rendering: the types of the cards in hand and the rule cards that could govern them, by name, in waves (a compound rule name is looked up once the wave before has found its parts)

law: round trips = 1 root + 1 prelude + 1 closure batch per nest level below the root + 2 wave = 4 + nest levels below the root

AND trash = 0 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), rules(rid, lid, db_content, type_id) AS ( SELECT r.id, r.left_id, r.db_content, r.type_id FROM cards r WHERE r.trash = 0 AND r.right_id = (SELECT id FROM setting)), up(rid, cur, suffix) AS ( SELECT rid, lid, '' FROM rules UNION ALL SELECT u.rid, c.left_id, '+' || COALESCE(rk."key", '') || u.suffix FROM up u JOIN cards c ON c.id = u.cur JOIN cards rk ON rk.id = c.right_id WHERE c.left_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(b."key", '') || u.suffix <> '' THEN COALESCE(b."key", '') || u.suffix || '+' || st."key" ELSE NULL END AS composed_key, rules.db_content AS db_content, rules.type_id AS rule_type_id FROM up u JOIN cards b ON b.id = u.cur AND b.left_id IS NULL AND b.right_id IS NULL JOIN rules ON rules.rid = u.rid JOIN cards st ON st.id = (SELECT id FROM setting) ORDER BY rules.rid
